scope: Independent requirement-to-artifact/evidence audit of the accepted two-issue processor delivery; no RTL changes and no certification claim.
accepted_scope_changes: Two-issue supersedes single-issue configuration and width-specific earlier records.
Five logical OoO sections supersede the original simple fixed in-order pipeline.
Firmware and FPGA/IP integration/bitstream work removed; retain selected Vivado/part/clock specifications.
User waived per-block checkpoint waits and extended the original time limit for full-core verification.
User chose fixed 64 KiB and explicitly accepted unexecuted I-jal-00 layout coverage gap.
method: Read active RTL, actual testbenches, guides, source lists and recorded test logs.
Recomputed every recorded local source hash and final ACT4 compiled-source/input/delivered-log hash against current files.
Checked exact final ELF manifest set, generated-source hashes and copied-environment adaptation hashes.
Compared complete-guide code blocks byte-for-byte with actual sources and explanation prefixes.
Audit checks evidence consistency; it does not rerun all 755125 observations or claim new coverage.

case_scopes.scope: configuration constants and packed instruction/queue record contracts
instruction decode, immediate construction, integer ALU, and branch conditions
four PRF reads, two writes, p0 protection, dual completion bypass
two-wide rename, intra-pair dependencies, dual completion/retirement, recovery
two-wide ROB ownership, ordered retirement/traps, recovery lock, registered trace
connected rename/ROB/PRF/trace handshakes with injected completion values
two-issue oldest-ready matching, source wakeup, resource and recovery gating
connected rename/ROB/PRF/IQ with modeled execution and injected completion
integer/control/address execution, iterative RV32M, retained results, cancellation
actual OoO arithmetic with connected rename/ROB/PRF/IQ/execution/trace
five-source/two-slot arbitration, retained outputs, accepted writeback, cancellation
real execution with production completion arbitration and accepted writeback
paired fetch, response credits, prefix buffering, prediction metadata, stale reads
synchronous instruction RAM through dual decode to actual OoO retirement
native synchronous row reads, held responses, range/alignment faults, block/drain
two-query BTB/PHT and ordered retirement training
actual loop trace equivalence with test-only recovery sequencing
production cancellation acknowledgment/quiescence barrier and safe apply sequencing
ordered memory queue and load/store request/response handling
serialized CSR commit, machine traps, interrupt eligibility and WFI
AXI-Lite master channels and machine timer/software interrupt slave
RAM-fed production core against independent instruction/architectural memory reference
precise faults, IRQ drain/return, WFI and recovery priority
actual core AXI memory, bus faults, FENCE.I and timer interrupts

requirements.accepted_requirement: One custom two-issue RV32IM_Zicsr_Zifencei out-of-order core; M-mode only.
requirements.actual_result: Production core composes all active architectural blocks. Fetch/dispatch/issue/completion/retirement limits are 2; 32 architectural and 64 physical registers.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Five logical IF/ID/EX/MEM/WB sections carrying complete valid instruction ownership.
requirements.actual_result: Fetch/FIFO, decode/rename, IQ/execution, ordered LSU, completion/ROB retirement are explicit clocked sections and queues.
requirements.limits: The accepted OoO plan supersedes a fixed four-register IF/ID-ID/EX-EX/MEM-MEM/WB in-order chain. Five sections do not imply five-clock latency or CPI=1.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Base RV32I arithmetic, shifts, logic, comparisons, upper immediates, all six branches, JAL/JALR, and byte/halfword/word memory operations.
requirements.actual_result: Decoder and datapaths implement the selected instruction families; full-core encoded programs and ACT4-derived ELFs execute on the actual core.
requirements.limits: One generated JAL layout program is unexecuted under the accepted 64 KiB decision; directed JAL/JALR tests pass.

requirements.accepted_requirement: All eight RV32M multiply/divide/remainder operations with an iterative independent execution resource.
requirements.actual_result: MUL/MULH/MULHSU/MULHU/DIV/DIVU/REM/REMU cover signedness, divide by zero, overflow, retained completion, cancellation and overlap with integer execution.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Six Zicsr forms, FENCE/FENCE.I, ECALL, EBREAK, MRET and WFI.
requirements.actual_result: System operations decode, issue only at the serialized head boundary, retain intent until retirement, and perform the documented restart/trap/wait effects.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Explain original SUBI/BEQZ/BNEQZ/JMP/LOOP/if-else and LD/SD names within the selected ISA.
requirements.actual_result: Instruction/hazard guide maps aliases and software control structures to base instructions; RV64 LD/SD are explicitly absent from this RV32 core.
requirements.limits: There is no custom LOOP/if-else opcode, no MIPS32 encoding, and no RV64 doubleword load/store promise.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Physical register file with four reads, two writes, p0 constant, and same-cycle accepted completion bypass.
requirements.actual_result: 63 stored 32-bit words plus constant p0; matching accepted completion values bypass each read port; duplicate nonzero writes are diagnosed.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Speculative/committed rename maps, free allocation, readiness, atomic resources and correct same-group dependencies.
requirements.actual_result: Dual rename captures source mappings before destination replacement, forwards lane-0 mappings to lane 1, allocates distinct destinations, updates committed mappings in retirement order, and restores them on recovery.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Handle RAW, WAR, WAW and structural hazards with explicit stalls/forwarding/renaming.
requirements.actual_result: Physical tags preserve RAW dependencies; readiness/wakeup and PRF bypass supply results. New physical versions remove WAR/WAW false dependencies. Atomic dispatch and execution/completion availability impose structural backpressure.
requirements.limits: Classical EX/MEM/MEM/WB in-order bypass selectors are replaced by the accepted OoO tag/completion architecture.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Eight-entry oldest-ready two-issue scheduling with execution-resource matching and continued integer work during DIV.
requirements.actual_result: Age-relative selection finds the oldest eligible instruction plus an eligible partner; port 0 supports control/address/system and port 1 supports integer/muldiv. Busy DIV does not block available integer execution.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Five simultaneous completion producers arbitrate to two retained writeback ports without result loss.
requirements.actual_result: Two ALUs, mul/div, LSU and system results hold ownership/payload; buffers arbitrate by age, apply backpressure and broadcast only ROB-accepted nonfaulting register results.

requirements.accepted_requirement: 16-entry ROB: completion may be out of order, architectural retirement up to two in program order.
requirements.actual_result: Full index/generation/destination/write-intent checks reject stale or duplicate results. Completed younger instructions cannot retire past an incomplete/faulting older head.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Demonstrate actual out-of-order behavior and an independent architectural reference.
requirements.actual_result: Recorded connected execution: DIV and independent ADD issue at cycle 6; ADD completes at 7, DIV at 39, dependent issue at 39, results 25/16/41. Full-core memory-fed programs use an independently written instruction/register/memory reference and ordered event comparisons.
requirements.limits: The local reference is custom project verification, not an independent certification authority or exhaustive equivalence proof.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Synchronous 64-bit instruction fetch, two instruction words, buffering, stalls and stale-response cancellation.
requirements.actual_result: One-outstanding row interface, four-instruction FIFO, reserved response credits, prediction snapshots, partial prefix compaction, access-error tokens and stale-response discard are implemented.
requirements.limits: Native RAM must have one synchronous read stage and hold its output when disabled. Extra BRAM stages require adaptation; storage and collision detection remain external.

requirements.accepted_requirement: 64-entry tagged BTB and 128-entry two-bit bimodal PHT, retirement training, disable mode and FENCE.I invalidation.
requirements.actual_result: Two IF lookups use tagged targets and saturating counters; ordered retirement updates fold both lanes, squashed work cannot train, disabled lookup is sequential, and invalidation resets prediction state.
requirements.limits: No global history, dedicated loop-count predictor or RAS; loop exits may mispredict. Block 10 early integration uses test-only recovery; production recovery is tested separately.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Safe retirement-based recovery with older-fault priority, cancellation acknowledgment, quiescence, committed map restoration and no unsafe identity reuse.
requirements.actual_result: RUN/CANCEL/APPLY captures a stable target, requires simultaneous aggregate acknowledgment AND quiescence, keeps cancel asserted during APPLY, then restores maps/flushes queues and redirects fetch.
requirements.limits: Conservative recovery waits for the precise retirement boundary. Older faults override younger redirects; executing/buffered owners are cancelled before tag reuse.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Memory-order queue depth 4, correct byte lanes/extensions/alignment and head-only external memory effects.
requirements.actual_result: Address/store-data preparation may execute early; one actual data transaction issues only for the live incomplete ROB head. Stores complete only after response; wrong-path RAM/MMIO reads and writes are suppressed.
requirements.limits: No speculative load issue/replay, memory disambiguation, store-to-load forwarding or multiple outstanding data transactions.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Instruction/load/store access errors and misalignment become precise exceptions without faulting destination writes.
requirements.actual_result: Error/alignment metadata retains instruction PC and effective address. Trap selection occurs at ROB head after older results; younger side effects are suppressed.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Machine CSRs including status, ISA, interrupts, trap vector/state, scratch, counters/high halves and identification with documented read-only/WARL behavior.
requirements.actual_result: mstatus/misa/mstatush/mie/mip/mtvec/mscratch/mepc/mcause/mtval/mcountinhibit, mcycle[h]/minstret[h], zero identification and mconfigptr are supplied. Counter writes suppress whole-counter implicit update on that edge.
requirements.limits: Machine-mode subset only; absent HPM/event-selector CSRs and user counter aliases trap. Fixed/WARL policies are documented, not a full privileged-profile claim.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Precise illegal instruction, ECALL, EBREAK, instruction/load/store alignment/access faults and MRET.
requirements.actual_result: Actual encoded instructions and memory-fed handlers read mcause/mepc/mtval, set an explicit resume PC and execute MRET. Fault owner, architectural PC, GPR results and event order are checked.
requirements.limits: Eleven synchronous-fault fixtures plus combined recovery scenarios are directed evidence, not every privileged corner case.

requirements.accepted_requirement: External/software/timer interrupts with direct/vectored mtvec, external > software > timer priority, drain/recheck and correct next unexecuted mepc.
requirements.actual_result: Admission stops on eligibility; admitted instructions and transactions drain; current masks are rechecked; architectural_next_pc rather than fetch PC is saved. Tests cover DIV/load timing, priorities, eligibility withdrawal and MRET.
requirements.limits: IRQ inputs must already be synchronous. ACT4 harness ties IRQs low; these interrupt results come from separate directed and AXI-timer tests.

requirements.accepted_requirement: WFI waits without gated clocks and observes local pending wake versus global interrupt enables.
requirements.actual_result: Locally enabled pending IRQ wakes WFI with global MIE=0 without a trap; MIE=1 causes precise interrupt entry and return. Clock remains running.

requirements.accepted_requirement: FENCE orders memory and FENCE.I makes modified executable RAM visible.
requirements.actual_result: Head-only memory plus serialized fences order prior accesses. FENCE.I invalidates predictor/prefetched state and redirects. AXI test confirms an old instruction was prefetched, overwrites it and retires the new word after FENCE.I.

requirements.accepted_requirement: AXI4-Lite master: independent channels, stable stalled payloads, exactly-once requests, response completion and fault propagation.
requirements.actual_result: Independent AW/W acceptance, held AR, one outstanding read/write, strobes, B/R errors and complete-core bus-error traps are exercised.
requirements.limits: Portable wrapper exposes AXI; production routing/interconnect/peripheral IP is outside revised scope.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Custom AXI machine timer/software interrupt slave and connected processor tests.
requirements.actual_result: MSIP, 64-bit MTIME and MTIMECMP support byte strobes and level IRQs. Complete-core programs set/clear actual MSIP and MTIMECMP through AXI and return from handlers.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Self-checking tests, timeouts, traces, waveform guidance, stress and current source-hashed evidence.
requirements.actual_result: All 15 groups pass 755125 checks; block15 contributes 29474 (16 ISA/data programs, 25 trap scenarios, 7 AXI programs). Wrap/reuse, queue pressure, arbitration, delayed results and recovery priorities are exercised.
requirements.limits: Counts are assertions/observations, not distinct instructions, functional coverage percentages, formal proofs or signoff. PRF free-list exhaustion is a unit stress; integrated ROB capacity normally stalls first.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Applicable ACT4-derived architectural programs with exact provenance/accounting, retained inputs and explicit gaps.
requirements.actual_result: All 135 delivered final self-checking ELFs pass with zero failed, rejected or timed-out inputs. Manifest exactly matches filenames/hashes; 136 generated source programs and environment are retained.
requirements.limits: Pinned 54-program I/M/Zicsr/Zifencei selection regenerated to 136 using upstream splitting. Three non-C alignment sites and three pointer-init prefixes are recorded adaptations. I-jal-00 layout gap was accepted by the user; no privileged ACT4/Sm certification.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Ready-to-run verification inputs without requiring a RISC-V compiler for initial local DUT simulation.
requirements.actual_result: 135 linked ELFs plus strict Python conversion are delivered; local tests and ELF execution need Python/Icarus/vvp. Source generation/rebuild requires the separately documented ACT4 compiler/Sail environment.
requirements.limits: These are verification executables, not the application firmware/startup/driver package removed from scope.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Readable block-by-block complete source, role/connection diagrams, signal widths/ownership, timing examples, tests/waves and interview answers.
requirements.actual_result: Fifteen complete guides include the exact complete active RTL and corresponding testbench files, with lesson prefixes and references. Every one of the 24 active RTL source files is represented verbatim.
requirements.limits: Pedagogical criteria are reviewed separately below; automatic keyword checks are only screening aids.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Reproducible package-first active compiler lists and separation from historical single-issue references.
requirements.actual_result: rtl/files.f lists exactly all 24 active .sv files once, package first. Runner reports record actual package-first source commands; historical duplicate modules are outside active lists.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Retain agreed Vivado 2026.1/Linux, Artix-7 xc7a35tcpg236-1, Basys3 reference, 100 MHz input, 50 MHz shared target and 64 KiB RAM specifications.
requirements.actual_result: Target note documents the selected environment, native-memory latency and external endpoint/clock/reset contracts; package constants retain the clock/RAM/address plan.
requirements.limits: No Vivado installation/part check, synthesis, fit, timing closure, DRC, constraints, implementation or bitstream result is supplied under the revised scope.

requirements.accepted_requirement: Exclude firmware and FPGA/IP integration as explicitly requested; continue without checkpoint waits after the time cap was extended.
requirements.actual_result: Portable custom RTL, tests and verification inputs remain delivered. No AMD block design/IP wrapper, board constraints, UART/GPIO integration, firmware runtime or bitstream flow is presented as completed.
requirements.limits: The original numbered integration/firmware blocks are intentionally removed, not silently counted as implemented. Checkpoint waits were waived by the user.

accepted_gaps_and_limits.detail: I-jal-00.S is retained but cannot link in 64 KiB: cumulative alignment yields image end 0x279c0. Tested offsets are within +/-8192. No cases were counted as passed; directed JAL/JALR programs pass.

ACT4-derived final ELF success covers the selected I/M/Zicsr/Zifencei configuration, not all possible programs or a certification profile. Privileged suites, optional CSR/WARL equivalence and Sm certification were not run.
No exhaustive formal proof, synthesis/latch report, FPGA resource fit, STA, DRC, CDC/RDC, power, silicon validation or advance guarantee is established by simulation.
Two is the maximum width, not a guaranteed IPC. Memory is head-only and one outstanding, divider is iterative, prediction recovery waits for retirement, and serialized operations cause stalls.

Supply synchronous IRQ levels, common clock/reset, one-stage held native RAM output, coherent shared little-endian storage/collision holds and AXI routing/endpoints. Reset endpoints consistently; old pre-reset responses must not alias new work.
No caches/DDR/MMU/OS boot, speculative load replay/store forwarding, global-history/loop predictor/RAS, U/S modes/PMP, FPU/vector/atomic/compressed ISA, multicore coherence or external debug module.

No AMD IP Integrator project, board wrapper, UART/GPIO IP, clock/reset IP, pin constraints, implementation/bitstream flow or application firmware/runtime/driver package; retain target specification only.
